_readme: Fill this out when you clone the template. Run /business-init to sync values into the codebase.

business.name: Dann Digital
business.description: Build beautiful websites, capture leads, manage teams. All in one platform.

branding._note: Colors are CSS hex values. logoUrl = Cloudinary/Supabase storage URL once uploaded.

contact._googleMapsUrl_note: Paste the Google Maps embed URL for the Contact Block iframe.

socials._note: Set to null to hide the icon in footer. Use full URLs.

socialProof._note: Displayed in the Social Proof Bar between hero and features.

seo._ogImage_note: Full URL to a 1200x630 image for social sharing previews.

deployment._appId_note: Must match NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_ID in .env.local — used for multi-project RLS isolation.
deployment._domain_note: e.g. 'danndigital.com' — used in sitemap.ts and canonical URLs.

supabase._note: Fill in after running: supabase projects list. Used by /checkpoint and /migrate.

features._note: Feature flags for Phase 7 verticals. Set true to scaffold the module.

client._note: If this repo is for a specific client, fill in their details. Used by /business-init to personalize the setup report.
